verdict.rationale: Jitsu Functions are a first-party, documented stage that processes data before it reaches a destination, with built-in Filter and Transform capabilities. This gives a general mechanism for modifying or removing sensitive attributes per destination. However, nothing documents PII-specific hashing, masking, or field-level redaction; these would have to be hand-written in JavaScript/TypeScript functions, and the documented Filter excludes whole events rather than fields. Missing for 10: native hashing/masking of PII fields, documented field-level filtering of sensitive attributes, explicit per-destination PII policy controls, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a privacy lead, I can control PII flow per destination — hashing, masking, and field-level filtering of sensitive attributes

citations.quote: Functions are designed to process data in Jitsu before it is sent to the destination.
Filter - Exclude data that fails to meet your specified criteria. Transform - Modify data to fit the schema of your destination.
Modify, filter or augment events before it is stored in your warehouse with Jitsu Functions.
